waived_gaps: T1-15: 2 numbers (7.3, 38.0) in The Painted Gallon - Facilitator Guide.docx not traced to case.md/case.json -- 7.3 is a SPEC section-number reference ("45-Minute Socratic Plan (SPEC §7.3)"), the same accepted false-positive class as the-deferred-repair's and roofline-call's own waived T1-15 entries (a doctrine/spec citation, not case data); 38.0 is the '38:00-45:00' timestamp label in the same 45-minute plan table, parsed as a bare number by the orphan-number sweep -- a clock-time boundary, not a data figure.
build_notes: Student docx built with the docx (npm) package, US Letter page size, dual DXA table/column widths, CLEAR table shading, and a real numbering config for the bullet/decimal/lower-alpha lists (no literal bullet glyphs). Mirrors case.md exactly (Overview through Appendix G) -- there is no content after case.md's <!-- FACILITATOR ONLY --> marker to strip (it is a bare guard comment, not facilitator prose), so nothing was omitted from case.md's own student-safe body. Verified leak-free by rendering to PDF (soffice --headless --convert-to pdf) and reading back all 8 pages: tables render uncut, hyperlinked sources resolve, the document ends at Appendix G's scope note with no trap/argument-for/margin content anywhere. Facilitator docx (separate file) carries the trap (including the newer D6 superficial-answer trap), both named arguments, the real 14.0% margin arithmetic, all seven Socratic questions, the boxed sensitivity note, the anchor ladder, the 45-minute plan, cohort bands, and the skills list. Data.xlsx ships raw Appendix A/B/C/D/G + Modeling Assumptions figures only (source-cited per cell, [S#] ids matching case.json), plus a blank D1-D6 work area -- no formulas, no pre-computed comparison, so no recalc.py run was needed. Interactive HTML built from templates/interactive_shell.html per INTERACTIVE_HTML_CONTRACT.md: the JS PARAMS/FLEX/evaluate()/evaluate_twist() block is a direct line-for-line port of cases/the-painted-gallon/sensitivity_model.py (same capacity^(2/3) area-scaling model, same four cited build/maintenance rates); the Working Notebook's six check functions (D1-D5 numeric, D6 a free-text draft box) validate against the case's own true idealized-geometry values and the ported evaluate() output, never a hardcoded verdict. Added a math GLOSSARY (8 terms: Sphere, Cylinder, Radius, Volume, Surface Area, Percent, Unit, Ratio -- Sphere/Cylinder/Radius/Volume/Surface Area/Percent links reused verbatim from other already-verified cases in this corpus per the contract doc's 'verified once, cited again' rule; Unit/Ratio reused from the shell's own verified starter glossary) plus a second STORY_GLOSSARY (6 water-utility/municipal-finance terms -- Water Tower, Boil-Water Advisory, Municipal Bond, Corrosion, Metal Fabrication, Water Supply Network -- all Wikipedia links, live-fetched and confirmed 2026-09-06 via WebFetch during this build) using the roofline-call dual-glossary pattern (.sterm class, separate render target and auto-linker, never colliding with T1-19's .gterm regex). Per instruction, readmodel/ was NOT touched -- packet build only.
